mechanics.claim: Kai'Sa's basic attacks apply 1 Plasma stack on-hit, and Void Seeker applies 2 stacks (3 if evolved).
mechanics.quote: Basic attacks each apply 1 stack and ''{{ai|Void Seeker|Kai'Sa}}'' applies 2 stacks, increased to 3 if it is {{ai|Void Seeker 2|Kai'Sa|evolved}}.

mechanics.claim: Each Plasma application deals the base plus per-stack Caustic Wounds magic damage; a fresh application refreshes the 4-second duration rather than stacking a new timer per stack.
mechanics.quote: '''Kai'Sa's''' basic attacks or ''{{ai|Void Seeker|Kai'Sa}}'' deal {{as|{{pplevel|4 to 30}} {{as|(+ 12% AP)}} '''additional''' magic damage|magic damage}} plus {{as|{{pplevel|1 to 8}} {{as|(+ 3% AP)}} '''additional''' magic damage|magic damage}} {{as|per Plasma stack before application|buzzword}}

mechanics.claim: The 5th Plasma stack consumes all stacks and deals the missing-health detonation damage instead of another stack application.
mechanics.quote: The fifth stack against a target consumes them all to deal {{as|'''additional''' magic damage|magic damage}} equal to {{as|15% {{as|(+ 6% per 100 AP)}} of the target's '''missing''' health|health}}

mechanics.claim: The missing-health detonation damage is evaluated after the initial Caustic Wounds damage and after Void Seeker's own damage if it triggered the detonation, but before a triggering basic attack's damage.
mechanics.quote: The bonus missing health damage is evaluated after the initial damage from ''Caustic Wounds'' is evaluated, and after {{ais|Void Seeker|Kai'Sa}} damage if triggered by it, but before a triggering basic attack's is.

mechanics.claim: Spell shield only blocks the Plasma application from Void Seeker, not from basic attacks.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} will block the {{as|Plasma|buzzword}} application from {{ai|Void Seeker|Kai'Sa}} only.

mechanics.claim: If Void Seeker detonates Plasma, any remaining stacks beyond the detonation are reapplied afterward, and Void Seeker's own damage is calculated as if each stack were applied successively.
mechanics.quote: With {{ai|Void Seeker|Kai'Sa}}, if the stacks detonate {{as|Plasma|buzzword}}, any remaining stacks are reapplied afterwards. {{ai|Void Seeker|Kai'Sa}} also deals ''Caustic Wounds' ''damage based on {{as|Plasma|buzzword}} stacks on the target. This damage is calculated as if each stack was applied successively.
